dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "-c", "print('Terraform AWS Provider Python Environment Ready')"]
explanation: Requirements include boto3 and botocore pinned to compatible versions for AWS API stability. Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim for minimal footprint, copies requirements first for layer caching efficiency, and includes a placeholder CMD since actual execution depends on Terraform's Go binary calling Python components.
